TOP RIGHT — dictionary (n.词典): A clear compact educational illustration of 'dictionary', specifically its curriculum meaning 'n.词典'; show a concrete object or minimal human situation that conveys precisely that meaning.

BOTTOM RIGHT — suit (v.适于): an adult trying a jacket that fits neatly and comfortably, verb be suitable, not just formal suit
